label: is subtype of
type: the subject is a specialisation of the object, as stated by the source ('Composite Vector Indexes ... which are Global Secondary Indexes (GSIs) with a single vector column').
note: PROMOTED BELOW THRESHOLD on significance: the registry had NO SUBSUMPTION VOCABULARY AT ALL - 195 concepts, 64 predicates, not one broader/narrower/isA relation - so a page whose entire content is a two-level taxonomy could not be expressed without minting. That is round 11's deepest structural finding: nine rounds of reference extraction produced a flat vocabulary because reference pages enumerate SIBLINGS (clauses of a statement, values of a setting) and never state hierarchy. Kept separate from belongsToIndexClass on purpose - see that record. When JSON-LD is drafted this is a candidate for rdfs:subClassOf, deliberately deferred rather than decided now: the source states a subtype relation between two index *types*, and whether those are classes or instances in the final model is exactly the question the JSON-LD pass exists to settle.
